baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ ... وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
baseline_models.mechanism: Anticipation of standing before the sovereign Lord turns fear into an act of self-government: the self is checked before its inclination controls conduct.

activation_trace.role: Fear as expectation of harm supplies the anticipatory pressure that precedes restraint.
Standing at resurrection supplies the accountable encounter toward which the person looks.
Lordship as ownership and sovereignty identifies the authority before whom standing matters.
Checking and forbidding supplies the deliberate intervention in the self's movement.
The self as the very entity makes the governed object the whole person, not one detached appetite.
Desire as the self's inclination supplies the directional pull that is restrained.

changed_reading.before: A person feels fear and suppresses a desire.
changed_reading.after: Anticipated accountable standing converts fear into deliberate governance of the whole self's inclination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The spatial opposition latent in مَقَام and هَوَىٰ, mediated by نَهَى.
baseline_models.mechanism: Standing, straightness, boundary, and falling form a kinetic model: restraint brings the self to a limit before inclination becomes descent.

activation_trace.role: Bodily uprightness supplies the stable vertical posture opposed to falling.
Straightness and balance turn standing into moral alignment rather than mere location.
An endpoint or boundary supplies the point at which the self's motion is arrested.
The self as a whole is the body-like entity whose orientation is at stake.
Falling into a depth converts inclination into a possible downward trajectory.
The self's desire keeps the spatial fall anchored to the focus word's immediate sense.

changed_reading.before: Restraint means saying no to an appetite.
changed_reading.after: Restraint is an act of keeping the whole self upright by ending an inclination before it becomes a fall.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ can keep the Lord's station or standing authority live alongside the person's standing before Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Awareness of the Lord's abiding, caring authority makes conduct occur under present oversight, so restraint is relational rather than only future-facing.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear makes sovereign presence behaviorally consequential.
Guardianship and sustained oversight supply an active governing sense to the station.
Abiding in a place supplies the felt presence carried by مقام.
Sovereign lordship identifies whose authority and presence govern the person.
Active checking is the conduct produced under that oversight.
Inclination is the private motion exposed to the Lord's governing presence.

changed_reading.before: The person fears a later courtroom-like appearance.
changed_reading.after: The person restrains private inclination while already living beneath the Lord's abiding governing presence, without excluding a future standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبِّهِ, نَهَى, and ٱلنَّفْسَ permit a formation model when the packet's split R-B-B/R-B-W inventory is preserved.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord repairs and nurtures growth, while reason supplies an intelligent check; restraint therefore trains the self's character instead of erasing it.

activation_trace.role: Repair, completion, and stepwise upbringing frame lordship as formative care.
The non-dominant mapped branch of feeding and growth extends formation into organic maturation.
Reason that prevents ugliness supplies the discerning faculty of self-training.
Character, resolve, and dignity make the self a capacity to form, not merely an appetite to crush.
Inclination supplies the living tendency that cultivation must shape.

changed_reading.after: Piety forms a living self under a nurturing Lord by giving discerning limits to inclination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence activates release after attachment, energetic movement, precedence, and outcome-aware management. Applied back to نَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ, restraint becomes active trajectory management that preserves energy while redirecting attachment.

activation_trace.role: Checking supplies the focus action that governs motion.
Resolve and character make the self an energetic agent rather than inert material.
Inclination supplies the motion needing direction.
Ceasing after attachment supplies a precise release mechanism for an already engaged desire.
Energetic readiness for movement keeps restraint from becoming lifeless suppression.
Precedence and racing supply directed priority to the redirected self.
Managing an affair by considering its outcome supplies the governing logic of restraint.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 forms an ordered participial sequence of force, motion, precedence, and management before the surah names judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered kinetic branches; I supply the analogy that they model the self's inner motion and the arrow release-to-redirection-to-management. A live alternative is that the opening agents remain wholly external to the psychology of 79:40.

changed_reading.before: Self-restraint is a static refusal to move toward desire.
changed_reading.after: Self-restraint releases an attachment and governs the self's retained energy toward a different priority and outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Palpitating hearts and lowered eyes make eschatological fear somatic. The focus ayah then distinguishes fruitful fear from mere bodily shock by giving it an agentive result: the person checks the self.

activation_trace.role: Fear visibly appearing on a person opens the focus word to bodily manifestation.
Deliberate checking marks the transition from symptom to ethical agency.
The heart supplies the bodily center in which the coming event is felt.
Palpitation and disturbance give fear a concrete somatic rhythm.
Lowering and submission supply the body's downward response to overwhelming fear.

structural_cues: 79:8-9 names involuntary heart and eye states, whereas 79:40 adds the transitive act وَنَهَى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily disturbance and lowered vision; I infer that 79:40 evaluates fear by the agency it produces. The alternative is that the two passages describe unrelated groups or moments without an intended contrast between symptom and action.

changed_reading.before: Fear in 79:40 is chiefly an abstract belief about accountability.
changed_reading.after: Fear can shake the body, but its distinctive value in 79:40 is that somatic alarm is converted into deliberate self-restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invitation to purification, gentle guidance toward the Lord, and ensuing awe give fear a formative sequence. خَافَ in the focus is therefore not bare panic but a learned, reverential perception capable of producing restraint.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear is the focus state revised by the preceding formative sequence.
Formative lordship makes guidance and purification coherent with the focus relation to the Lord.
Reason that checks ugliness supplies the mature agency produced by guidance.
Purity and rectitude supply the invited transformation before fear appears.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the means by which reverence is learned.
Fear joined with awe and majesty qualifies the affective state toward which guidance leads.

structural_cues: 79:18-19 orders the invitations as تَزَكَّىٰ, أَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ, then فَتَخْشَىٰ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the verbal order purification-to-guidance-to-awe; I read that order as formative causation and carry its quality of fear into خَافَ. The live alternative is that the verbs are coordinated aims rather than stages in a causal process.

changed_reading.before: Fear compels restraint by threat alone.
changed_reading.after: Purification and guidance educate perception into reverential fear, from which intelligent self-restraint can follow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh's disobedience and self-exaltation display public transgression; the final paired clauses identify its inner operation as preference. Against that chain, نَهَى becomes boundary-setting inside the self before desire can grow into overreach.

activation_trace.role: A reached limit supplies the internal boundary opposed to transgression.
Selfhood as character and pride locates the contest within the agent capable of exaltation.
Inclination supplies the private preference that can develop into outward overreach.
Departure from obedience supplies Pharaoh's enacted refusal of rightful rule.
Arrogant greatness supplies the self-exalting form taken by unbounded agency.
Crossing the limit in disobedience names the condition directly contrasted with the focus subject.
Choosing one thing over another supplies the decision procedure through which desire becomes allegiance.

structural_cues: 79:17-25 narrates transgression as disobedience and a claim to supremacy.
79:37 and 79:40 repeat فَأَمَّا مَن to place transgression and self-restraint in direct parallel opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public disobedience, self-exaltation, limit-crossing, preference, and the paired syntax; I infer that unrestrained inner preference is a micro-mechanism of tyrannical overreach. The alternative is that the pair classifies outcomes without mapping private desire onto Pharaoh's politics.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes private ascetic control of appetite.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes anti-transgressive self-government: setting an inner limit before preference becomes disobedience, supremacy, and domination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Growth and purification, shepherding care, and useful enjoyment strengthen the focus-only cultivation model. Restraining desire is selective formation within provision, not rejection of every benefit or destruction of appetite.

activation_trace.role: Repair and upbringing frame the Lord-self relation as formative care.
The split mapped branch of feeding and organic growth makes cultivation materially vivid.
Discerning reason supplies selective regulation rather than indiscriminate negation.
Living inclination is the capacity being cultivated and bounded.
Growth and increase supply a positive developmental aim for self-restraint.
Shepherding and protective care turn pasture into an image of guarded flourishing.
Useful and pleasurable benefit keeps created enjoyment inside the model rather than treating it as evil.

structural_cues: The purification invitation in 79:18 and the pasture-and-enjoyment sequence in 79:31-33 place moral growth beside legitimate provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, care, and beneficial enjoyment; I infer that the Lord's formative relation gives desire a cultivable form and that prohibition prunes rather than annihilates it. The alternative is that purification and provision are separate arguments with no horticultural psychology.

changed_reading.before: Restraining desire means refusing created enjoyment as such.
changed_reading.after: Restraining desire cultivates the self so that created benefits remain provision under care rather than becoming sovereign inclinations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky's straightening and the mountains' solid anchoring give material scale to the focus opposition between standing and falling. Self-restraint becomes an interior act of alignment and stabilization within a deliberately ordered world.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and balance make مقام an orientation within order.
A terminal boundary supplies the stabilizing check.
Falling supplies the destabilizing trajectory opposed by alignment and anchoring.
Straightness and completion supply the cosmic pattern of ordered alignment.
A gathered, elevated solid mass supplies the material body that resists drift.
Firm fixation supplies the anchoring action that keeps the ordered world stable.

structural_cues: 79:27-32 moves from construction and straightening above to spreading below and fixing the mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic straightening, solidity, and fixation; I supply the microcosmic arrow that the same material logic illuminates the self's standing against a fall. The live alternative is that the creation sequence demonstrates power only and does not model moral stability.

changed_reading.before: The person's restraint is an isolated inward prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The person performs an interior analogue of cosmic ordering, aligning and anchoring the self against a downward trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: A voiced check, an exemplary deterrent, and a warning that awakens caution form external modes of arrest across the surah. In the focus ayah, the person internalizes that arrest and becomes the immediate agent who checks the self before external compulsion arrives.

activation_trace.role: Inducing fear to provoke caution makes warning behaviorally active.
Checking supplies the inward counterpart to the surah's external arresting acts.
A forceful voiced check supplies the abrupt external arrest at the resurrection turn.
Punishment that deters observers supplies an exemplary social restraint.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the communicative trigger for voluntary restraint.

structural_cues: The arresting terms occur at the resurrection turn (79:13), the close of Pharaoh's example (79:25), and the messenger's final task (79:45).
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three external deterrent forms; I infer an internalization arrow in which the focus subject administers the needed check before shout, punishment, or warning must compel him. The alternative is that these forms only frame judgment and do not describe stages of moral agency.

changed_reading.before: The person merely obeys an externally imposed prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The warned person internalizes the surah's arresting force and becomes capable of checking the self before external deterrence takes over.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired ending converts desire into a trajectory of valuation and habitation: preference selects the near or lower life, that selection tends toward a settled abode, and restraint interrupts the trajectory before inclination becomes destination.

activation_trace.role: Checking supplies the interruption between present inclination and eventual abode.
Desire as inclination supplies the initial directional preference.
Falling toward a depth makes the directional consequence of unchecked inclination spatially visible.
Preference by active choice supplies the valuation step through which inclination directs life.
The nearer or lower world supplies the object favored by short-range valuation.
Blazing heat supplies one terminal environment of the chosen trajectory.
Joining a gathering refuge turns repeated choices into a settled abode.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies the alternative terminal environment after restraint.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 presents two فَأَمَّا مَن conditions and repeats فَإِنَّ ... هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ around the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies preference, the near or lower life, and opposed abodes; I infer the directional arrow inclination-to-priority-to-habitation and place restraint at its interrupting point. The alternative is a purely juridical relation between deeds and outcomes rather than a kinetic one.

changed_reading.before: Restraint blocks a momentary private urge.
changed_reading.after: Restraint interrupts the process by which an inclination becomes a chosen priority and repeated priority becomes one's abode.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing questions seek the Hour's mooring, name its final endpoint with the same N-H-Y root as the focus verb, and compress worldly duration to an evening or morning. The person who restrains desire enacts a proximate limit under the Lord who owns the final limit, with temporal rescaling making that limit rational.

activation_trace.role: A station or period of abiding supplies the duration against which the closing time-compression is measured.
Sovereign lordship identifies the owner of the ultimate endpoint.
An endpoint reached by a thing makes restraint an act of bringing desire to a limit.
Present inclination is the motion assigned a near boundary under final time.
Asking and seeking supply the pressure to locate the final event in time.
A ship's stopping and mooring supply the image of the Hour reaching its fixed berth.
Dwelling in a place supplies the duration that is retrospectively compressed.
Evening supplies one short bound of the perceived worldly stay.
The span of morning supplies the other short bound of the perceived worldly stay.

structural_cues: 79:40 نَهَى and 79:44 مُنتَهَىٰهَا repeat N-H-Y within four ayat.
79:42 مُّرْسَىٰهَا, 79:44 مُنتَهَىٰهَا, and 79:46 the evening-or-morning comparison form a closing sequence of mooring, endpoint, and compressed duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the N-H-Y repetition, mooring image, ownership of the endpoint, and compressed stay; I infer a microcosmic arrow in which personal restraint sets a present limit aligned with finality and temporal perspective. Alternatives remain live: the root repetition may be non-mechanistic polysemy, and the duration comparison may describe perception without motivating restraint.

changed_reading.before: The person suppresses desire because a remote future event is frightening.
changed_reading.after: The person gives present inclination its proper endpoint under the Lord's final endpoint, seeing the apparently durable world as only an evening or morning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare N-H-Y pool branch and the H-W-Y falling branch rather than taking نَهَى and هَوَىٰ only in their immediate moral senses. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains material support from water and fixation in 79:31-32. Downstream prose should present it only as a hydraulic analogy for channeling and settling desire, not as a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ as endpoint, life-bearing self, and downward current.

activation_trace.role: A pool where floodwater reaches its end supplies a basin that arrests and settles a current.
Water by which life is sustained makes the restrained self something to preserve rather than drain.
Falling into a depth supplies the downward current caught at the terminal basin.
Ordinary water supplies the explicit material activated in the creation sequence.
Firm fixation supplies the settling force that prevents the current from becoming an uncontrolled fall.

changed_reading.before: Restraint destroys or damns up the force of desire.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, restraint catches a downward current at a stable endpoint so its life-bearing force can settle without sweeping the self away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reaches from مَقَام to the Q-W-M valuation branch and from نَفْس to the precious-object branch, neither of which should replace the immediate syntax. It remains focus-anchored and becomes coherent beside loss, benefit, and preference elsewhere in the packet. Downstream prose should label it an economic root-branch analogy about moral appraisal, not construe مَقَام as a direct synonym for price.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَقَامَ, ٱلنَّفْسَ, and ٱلْهَوَىٰ recast as appraisal, a precious self, and misdirected preference.

activation_trace.role: Valuation and appraisal supply an exploratory moral-accounting dimension to مقام.
A precious thing for which selves compete makes the self an asset liable to misvaluation.
Inclination supplies the preference that can assign value badly.
Commercial loss supplies the negative accounting outcome feared by the deniers.
Useful enjoyment supplies real benefit that must be valued without becoming ultimate.
Preferential choice supplies the act by which relative values are enacted.

changed_reading.before: Desire is only an appetite to be denied.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, desire is a faulty appraisal that spends a precious self on a nearer benefit, while awareness of the Lord's appraisal restores scale.

strongest_changes: The Pharaoh and final contrast turn private restraint into anti-transgressive self-government: inner preference is stopped before it becomes disobedience and supremacy.
The paired abodes turn desire into a trajectory from inclination through chosen priority to habitation, with restraint interrupting that trajectory.
The closing N-H-Y repetition and mooring language recast نَهَى as giving desire a present endpoint under the Lord's final endpoint.
Purification, guidance, and awe revise fear from panic into an educated reverence capable of deliberate action.
Creation's straightening and anchoring strengthen the latent مقام-versus-هَوَىٰ opposition of upright stability and fall.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made three distant mechanisms converge on the focus without collapsing them: Pharaoh supplies the social scale of unbounded selfhood, creation supplies material models of cultivation and stability, and the closing verses supply preference, abode, endpoint, and temporal scale. The focus ayah becomes a compact hinge where fear is converted into governed motion.
remaining_uncertainties: مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ can sustain both the person's future standing before the Lord and awareness of the Lord's own standing authority; the trace keeps both live.
The causal reading of purification, guidance, and awe is inferred from sequence and may instead be coordination.
The R-B-W growth activation is packet-authorized but form-distant from رَبِّ and should remain exploratory.
The opening kinetic, hydraulic, and appraisal readings are mechanisms by analogy, not claims that rare branches replace immediate lexical senses.
